audit.description: Full SEO execution: discovery, technical and on-page checks, content quality, keyword fit, prioritisation, history comparison and report.

steps.purpose: Load the website config, open findings, decisions and last executions.
Map the current site: sitemap, robots, key pages, metadata, headings, links.
Normalise any new SEO reports into findings.
steps.when: new report files were supplied or found in the configured report folders

steps.purpose: Site-wide crawlability, indexability, redirects, status codes, canonicals.
claude-seo category sweep (technical, content, schema, images, AI search) without scores.
steps.when: the user asks for the full claude-seo style audit

steps.purpose: Diagnose the configured key pages.
Validate JSON-LD against visible content.
Orphans, thin inbound links, anchor quality.
Thin content, outdated facts, unsupported claims, site editorial rules.
Pages competing for one intent.
steps.when: Search Console query/page data or a keyword map is available

steps.purpose: Check key pages still match their target intent and keywords.
steps.when: keyword research exists in the knowledge base

steps.purpose: AI crawler access and passage citability.
steps.when: the site targets AI answer surfaces

steps.purpose: Order findings into Critical/High/Medium/Low with the rubric shown.
Record findings, skills and tools, compare with history and write the report.

competitor-analysis.description: Who ranks for the site's topics, how their pages are built, and which gaps are worth closing.

steps.purpose: Load configured competitors, keyword research and previous competitor snapshots.
Observe live results for target keywords in the configured markets.
Domain-level keyword gap.
Map competitor-only topics to intent and an owner page.
Assess comparison/alternatives page opportunities.
steps.when: comparison intent appears in the SERPs

steps.purpose: Turn gaps into a content plan without duplicating existing pages.
Order the gap actions.
Save a dated competitor snapshot and the execution report.

content-optimization.description: Improve existing pages: titles, descriptions, headings, structure, internal links, FAQs, freshness and quality.

steps.purpose: Load editorial rules, rejected recommendations and open content findings.
Read the current state of the target pages (live and in the repository).
Diagnose each target page.
Concrete edits: title, description, headings, answer-first sections, FAQs.
Natural inbound links from related posts.
Originality, factual accuracy, no stuffing, house style.
Brief for a page that does not exist yet.
steps.when: a new page is the right fix

steps.purpose: Draft content from an approved brief.
steps.when: the user explicitly asks for content to be written

steps.purpose: Order the edits.
Record proposed and implemented changes and the report.

performance-review.description: What changed in Search Console and why, and whether earlier changes worked.

steps.purpose: Load previous metrics and implemented changes with their dates.
Period-over-period clicks, impressions, CTR and position by segment.
Differential diagnosis of drops and low CTR.
steps.when: a drop or anomaly needs explaining

steps.purpose: Queries split across pages.
Order the follow-up actions.
Append sourced metrics, judge implemented changes, write the report.

update-skills.description: Review pending skill proposals and apply only approved ones.

steps.purpose: Find recurring patterns across executions that justify a methodology change.
Show proposals, record the human decision, apply approved ones.
